src.yaml.Diagrams.1-checkout.1.name: An internal diagram, what a block is made of. Its parts meet through typed ports; the room's own port sits on its wall.

src.yaml.Diagrams.2-payment-retry.1.name: A flowchart. It starts and ends at its marks; a decision's lines say where each answer goes.

src.yaml.Diagrams.3-order-states.1.name: A state machine, ranked by where its transitions point. Each transition is named by the event that fires it.

src.yaml.Diagrams.4-checkout-saga.name: Checkout saga
src.yaml.Diagrams.4-checkout-saga.description: A sequence: each column a participant, each row a moment, each line a message.

src.yaml.Diagrams.4-checkout-saga.3.name: Checkout
src.yaml.Diagrams.4-checkout-saga.3.body: A participant may refer to the block it stands for.

src.yaml.Diagrams.5-fulfilment.name: Fulfilment
src.yaml.Diagrams.5-fulfilment.description: A swimlane: columns are lanes, rows are phases, each step in the cell of who does it and when.

src.yaml.Diagrams.5-fulfilment.8.name: Pick items
src.yaml.Diagrams.5-fulfilment.8.body: Stock is taken off the shelf.

src.yaml.Diagrams.5-fulfilment.9.name: Book carrier
src.yaml.Diagrams.5-fulfilment.9.body: The adapter books a pickup in the carrier's terms.

src.yaml.Diagrams.6-model.1.name: The records as classes — fields, then behaviours — joined by the associations stored between them, each end saying how many and in what role. Order status is a type, so it draws no card of its own.

src.yaml.Diagrams.7-schema.1.name: The records as an entity relationship diagram — columns and keys — the same associations drawn as crow's feet.

src.yaml.Diagrams.8-estate.name: Estate
src.yaml.Diagrams.8-estate.description: The gallery as a treemap, each tile as large as what it holds.

src.yaml.Diagrams.8-estate.1.name: A treemap layer. Each tile is as large as the block it stands for holds; the groups gather them as the gallery's folders do.

src.yaml.Faces.1-small.1.name: Every card on its small face, the name and marks alone; the icon says what sort of thing it is.

src.yaml.Faces.2-large.1.name: Every large face. A layer whose cards are large draws what each says under its name.

src.yaml.Faces.2-large.4.name: Runbook
src.yaml.Faces.2-large.4.body:
# When orders stop flowing

Check the **relay** first. See the [outbox pattern](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html).

| signal | threshold | page |
|---|---|---|
| outbox rows | 10 000 | yes |
| relay lag | 60 s | no |

src.yaml.Faces.2-large.5.name: Charge once
src.yaml.Faces.2-large.5.body: Checkout retries the same request. The order service treats a repeated checkout key as the order it already created, so a retry never charges twice.

src.yaml.Faces.2-large.7.name: Release notes
src.yaml.Faces.2-large.7.body: v2 of the orders API: the checkout key is required.

src.yaml.Faces.2-large.8.name: Incident summary
src.yaml.Faces.2-large.8.body: Checkout was slow for twenty minutes while the card processor timed out. The breaker opened, the fallback queued charges, and every queued charge was taken once the processor came back.

src.yaml.Records.ledger.name: Ledger
src.yaml.Records.ledger.description: A collection: many records of one type, drawn as a table on its card. Records are values, never blocks.

src.yaml.Records.line.name: Line
src.yaml.Records.line.description: One product on an order, and how many.

src.yaml.Records.order.name: Order
src.yaml.Records.order.description: A customer's request, and the lines on it.

src.yaml.Records.order.1.name: place
src.yaml.Records.order.1.description: Takes a customer's lines and gives back the order they make.

src.yaml.Records.payment.name: Payment
src.yaml.Records.payment.description: A charge taken against an order.

src.yaml.Registries.1-tagged.1.name: Tags with parents and colours. A parent's colour reaches the tags under it; pick a block and its components tab lists its tags, each in its colour.

src.yaml.Registries.2-owned.1.name: A constraint applied by name. Each block here must name its owner; check reports any that does not.

src.yaml.Registries.3-wired.1.name: Interface definitions, each in its colour. A port typed by one wears it; Checkout's ports are its uses too.

src.yaml.Visuals.1-lines.1.name: Every relation the base ships, and the ways a line points. A line's ends say how many, in what role, and who owns whom.

src.yaml.Visuals.2-groups.1.name: Groups nest, each a dashed box round its members, a note tied beside it. A grid lays cells under its headers.

src.yaml.Visuals.3-bands.1.name: Regions cut a layer into bands, each under its heading; a region's name tags what lies in it, and a label tags what it is tied to.

src.yaml.Visuals.4-colour.1.name: Colour and line, set on a card. A family or a hue picks its colour; fill, border and opacity say how it is drawn.

src.yaml.about.1.name: Gallery
src.yaml.about.1.body:
# What mndflow draws

Every example uses only the base package.

| Folder | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Diagrams | one example per diagram kind, in kind order |
| Registries | types, tags, interfaces and constraints, each with its uses |
| Faces | small and large cards: table, class, document, picture, text |
| Visuals | lines and their ends, ties, ports, groups, grids, regions, labels, notes, colour |
